deudas.chart_note_projection: The line shows the remaining pending balance after each period. It is built from each debt's last pending installment: grouped by month if everything ends within 12 months or less, and by year if the horizon is longer. It is a reference and may vary with late fees, interest or adjustments.
deudas.chart_note_history: Shows the total amount owed at the end of each month and how many debts make it up. The amount is rebuilt from installments: whatever was paid up to that month is deducted. A debt stops counting when it is paid/closed or deleted. The pending balance is a reference and may vary with late fees or interest.

help.title: Where do I find this data?
help.step1: Open the Mailgun SMTP configuration screen in a new tab.
help.step2: Copy the SMTP server (host) shown there and paste it into the "SMTP Server" field.
help.step3: Copy the port (usually 587) into the "Port" field.
help.step4: Use the email of your Mailgun account as "Username".
help.step5: Create or use the SMTP password shown by Mailgun and paste it into "Password".
help.step6: Fill in the "From email" (where emails are sent from) and the "From name".

help.title: Where do I find this data?
help.step1: Get your Key/API token on the Voice Monkey tokens page.
help.step2: Copy it and paste it into the "API token" field.
help.step3: Choose the speaker where you want alerts announced on the speakers page.
help.step4: Copy the corresponding Device and paste it into the "Device" field.

telegram_bot.title: Telegram Bot
telegram_bot.enable_hint: Query services with pending bills from Telegram and receive Telegram alerts.

telegram_bot.needs_config_hint: A token is required to complete the setup.

help.title: How do I create the bot?
help.step1: Talk to @BotFather on Telegram and use the /newbot command.
help.step2: Copy the token BotFather gives you and paste it into the "Bot token" field.
help.step3: Send a message to the bot (e.g. /pendientes) to test it.
help.step4: Get your chat ID (e.g. with @userinfobot) and paste it into "Allowed chat IDs" to receive Telegram alerts.

telegram_bot.separator_length_hint: Number of dashes in the summary divider line (0-100). 0 = no separator.
